# Frame Extractor Technical Overview

Frame Extractor is a browser-based utility for precise video frame extraction. It uses the requestVideoFrameCallback API to synchronize UI playback with underlying media timestamps. The tool operates locally via URL.createObjectURL, meaning video data stays in browser memory and is not uploaded to a server. Performance depends on local hardware: 1080p and 4K60
